---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an addition or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Use case

What problem does this feature solve, or what workflow does it enable? Be specific — "I want to ask Claude about X" is more useful than "it would be nice to have Y".

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to see added or changed. If you have a concrete API in mind (e.g. a new tool name and parameters), include it here.

## Alternatives considered

Have you found any workarounds or alternative approaches? Why are they insufficient?

## Additional context

Any other context, references, or examples. If this is about adding a data provider, link to its documentation and note whether it requires an API key.

---

**Before submitting**, please check:
- [ ] This is within the project's scope (US stocks, daily resolution, MDD/analytics tools — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] There isn't already an open issue or PR for this
